name: Boondaego Spitecraft
who: Boondaego sold magical gear and later served as a rebellion general. At Krezk he helped the party fight Strahd and died after going back into the fight.

name: Kolyan Indirovich
who: The burgomaster of Barovia village separated the sunlight from the Sunsword as part of a bargain to protect Ireena. Strahd killed him in single combat and returned his body to her.

name: Father Lucien
who: The priest at St. Andral's offered Ireena shelter and told the party that the church had lost its protection. The party later heard that he had been killed.

name: Argynvost
who: The silver dragon once defended the land against Strahd. His spirit spoke through the Sunsword and later appeared at Argynvostholt when the beacon was restored.
